reaction_description: Hydrogenation of an alkene over 5 wt% Pd/C
raw_text: A 0.10 M ethanol solution of an alkene is hydrogenated over 5 wt% Pd/C at 50 C and 10 bar hydrogen for 4 h in batch. Design a continuous packed-bed process with gas-liquid mixing, catalyst retention, pressure control, and startup/shutdown safeguards.
